Method of Attack: Exploitation of Log4Shell vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228) to gain unauthorized access
Use of vulnerable Log4j version in Cyclos payment software
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Log4Shell vulnerability on Cyclos server
Misconfigured Amazon S3 buckets allowing further data access
Indicators of Compromise: Data breach of nearly 2 million ONUS customer records
Data posted for sale on data breach marketplace forums
Samples of customer ID cards, passports, and video selfie clips leaked
